title: Polar area element and radial integration
section: Double Integrals ▷ Double Integrals in Polar Coordinates
terms: polar double integral; polar area element; radial bound; polar substitution.

exposition.text:
Under x = r cos θ, y = r sin θ with r ≥ 0, the area element is dA = r dr dθ. Therefore transform
the integrand, the region, and the area element together. For α ≤ θ ≤ β and r (θ) ≤ r ≤ r (θ),
1 2
integrate f(r cos θ, r sin θ)r over those bounds.
The extra factor r accounts for the increasing width of angular sectors. Shifted circles often
2 2
have nonconstant bounds: x + y = 2ax becomes r = 2a cos θ, with angles restricted so that the
bound is nonnegative. Avoid counting a region twice when a polar curve retraces itself. Symme-
try can shorten angular intervals only when the transformed integrand shares the symmetry.
